data.assumption: I interpreted “refunds were processed in Tamil Nadu yesterday” as refunds with status 'processed' on business_date 2026-09-09 for orders from showrooms in the Tamil Nadu region.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN payment_attempts pa ON pa.attempt_id = r.attempt_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = s.region_id
WHERE o.is_test = FALSE
  AND pa.is_test = FALSE
  AND r.status = 'processed'
  AND r.business_date = DATE '2026-09-09'
  AND rg.name = 'Tamil Nadu'
